headline: Island Fronts Flare; Attrition Belts Intensify
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the contested islands have produced a fresh wave of ownership changes while the massive attrition corridors continue to bleed without territorial shift. Farranac Coast logged four captures in the past two hours, the latest at 17:27 UTC around Scythe and Mara, raising its 24‑hour flip total to seven. Fishermans Row recorded four flips in the same window, most recently at 16:10 UTC near Arcadia and Peripti Landing, pushing its daily tally to twelve. Tempest Island added four captures since 15:10, the newest at 17:53 UTC at Blackwatch, Isle of Psyche and Surge Gate, for a 24‑hour total of thirteen. Godcrofts saw two fresh flips at 17:27 UTC around Lipsia and Argosa, bringing its day‑long count to twelve. Lykos Isle registered a single new turnover at 16:10 UTC near Fort Guile and The Squall, keeping its 24‑hour activity at twenty‑five. Dead Lands, though quiet in the last two hours, remains the bloodiest sector with roughly 2,075 Colonial and 2,267 Warden casualties in the latest two‑hour window and nine flips over the past day. Meanwhile the high‑casualty belts — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — show accelerating losses on both sides with no change in strategic‑base ownership, which still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
